notes: invoiceQueryOptions (src/main.tsx:52-56) declares queryKey: ['invoice'] with no per-invoice discriminator, so two sibling useSuspenseQuery(invoiceQueryOptions(id)) subscriptions on the InvoicesCompareComponent share a single cache entry. Whichever invoice resolves first wins; both panes render the same data. Spec at tests/cache-leak.spec.ts navigates to /dashboard/invoices-compare/1/2 and asserts pane A holds 'Invoice 1' AND pane B holds 'Invoice 2'; the planted regression makes pane B receive Invoice 1's body, so the second toHaveValue assertion times out with received 'Invoice 1' / expected 'Invoice 2'. Pure component bug — spec is correct (side-by-side render contract). Snapshot-distinguishable in principle: a captured tree at the failing step would show both <InvoiceFields> nodes carrying invoice.id=1 while the parent props say idA=1, idB=2, which is the direct fingerprint of the cache collision. NOTE: no snapshot.json is committed for this case yet — capturing it requires harness changes to inject the probe against a forked OSS host (issue tracked separately). Without a snapshot the ablation with-/without-snapshot variants see identical inputs for this case and contribute 0 to the delta; the case still anchors the corpus entry for when capture is wired.
